forum.title: Cannot start AEK-COM-10BASET project from AutoDevKit 2.7
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi Suknam,

Yes, you can find 2 AEK-COM-10BASET demo applications in AutoDevKit Studio.

To find these projects you have to check the AEK demo library. Make sure to follow these steps:

1. Click on "Import Samples"![SRomeo_2-1776179633518.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/cac1bdb0-05d7-2152-f8c4-99df932b1e61.png "SRomeo_2-1776179633518.png")

2. Select "All families" and click next

![SRomeo_1-1776179389666.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/2ccf5b83-541a-ee59-7947-a0ab188d5202.png "SRomeo_1-1776179389666.png")

3. search for "10base" and select the project you prefer![SRomeo_0-1776179332787.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/6000a8b9-7a64-5b23-1754-c85e79fbf5ac.png "SRomeo_0-1776179332787.png")

Once imported you should be able to see the source code from the project explorer (on the left).

To understand more about these demos, take a look to the [AEK-COM-10BASET UM](https://www.st.com/resource/en/user_manual/um3460-how-to-use-the-aekcom10baset-twochannel-10baset1s-packet-converter-evaluation-board-stmicroelectronics.pdf) (chapter 2.1)

Best Regards,

Simone

AEK\_Team
forum.content_text:
Hello,

I installed AutoDevKit Studio today and trying to create the AEK-COM-10BASET project from it.

Basically there is no option to create / start the AEK-COM-10BASET from AutoDevKit.

Also I tried to run Help > Install New Software > Work with <http://autodevkit.spc5studio.com/> > Choose AEK-COM-10BASET > install the module.

![1.jpg](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/89ea4820-017f-ff28-1bf9-79f1413c7316.jpg "1.jpg")

Even I tried couple of times it always fails due to unknown reason. After Fetching children step, the SW says "Cannot perform operation.", the SW tries to install some modules, and finally nothing is improved.

Still I cannot start any AEK-COM-10BASET project.

If I try to install the SW modules for AEK-COM-10BASET, it says below error message.

![2.jpg](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/d7ea2a8f-353c-5cf2-a50b-204564193f4c.jpg "2.jpg")

And stucks here, I cannot move further. No AEK-COM-10BASET related menu items / projects are found, I cannot start.

![3.jpg](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/8fe3ed50-e3da-a5a6-6a29-927fd28ba64d.jpg "3.jpg")

I want to get the AEK-COM-10BASET project source code, change something and do some of my own tests.

Any help / comment are appreciated !!!

BR,

apap
